title: Change-impact skill
summary: Trace the parts of a system affected by a proposed change and identify what needs verification.

sections.label: Inputs
sections.text: The proposed outcome, known component and data dependencies, relevant versions, consumer contracts and existing checks.

sections.label: Graph application example
sections.text: For an RDF application, the inputs may include ontology concepts, TTL and query locations, service revisions and API consumers. These are one implementation of the general dependency investigation.

sections.label: Procedure
sections.text: Follow known relationships and actual references. Identify direct effects, migrations, consumer contracts, and test scenarios. Label indirect impacts as hypotheses until checked.

sections.label: Output
sections.text: Affected component map, dependency order, suggested verification, and evidence for each impact.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: A claimed impact links to a source relationship, code reference, contract, or executed observation.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
